Payment result (BR-PAY-04 / 05 / 07): notify entries POST /notify/pay/{wechat,alipay} outside the client contract (verification and decryption by the PayChannel adapter, rejections counted and alerted without business data, answers per the 08 answer table incl. not-found nack, per-address fixed-window rate limit over platform REDIS), pay_notifications dedupe, identity / order / amount / success_states checks that fail closed, PO2 + PAY_RECEIPT voucher via the ledger post port + pay_order.paid event + biz.reconcile fulfillment job in one transaction (any failure rolls back, the query attempt row stays, no success answer), order.query handler (next schedule slot or hand to order.close at expire_at; a paid answer on a CLOSED order is an anomaly receipt: pay_anomalies + PAY_ANOMALY + recon_diffs pay_anomaly, never PO2, registered once per anomaly row), duplicate / concurrent notifications settle once. EVENT_NAMES += pay_order.paid (02 §11 +1, D10-338 / D10-340, couli #204 / #206; the two frozen event fixtures gain that one item). Receipt vouchers are registered in specs/ledger-rules.md only (csv / templates.gen / fund.yaml enum follow in B2-15x, D10-338 ②). Open S2 carried as follow-up: biz.reconcile singletonKey lacks app_id (frozen rule tests pin the literal key; B2-15x / test-change). Orchestrated by pay-acct4 (Claude Fable 5.1). Ledger PR #1187, test_paths #1549.
